title: Implementation cost, sequencing, and adversarial risk estimate
objective: Estimate the engineering cost of bringing this project to the proposed display strategy and produce an evidence-based phased delivery plan with uncertainty ranges and pre-mortem risks.

include: Engineering, test, UX/accessibility, review, and stabilization effort
Dependencies, critical path, parallelizable work, regression risk, and rollback boundaries
Adversarial review of assumptions, alternatives, scale, reversibility, and likely failure modes

deliverables: Low/base/high person-day estimates by workstream and phase
A dependency-aware implementation sequence and suggested ownership
Top risks, leading indicators, mitigations, and explicit estimate assumptions
acceptance_criteria: Estimates are tied to concrete repository touch points and test obligations
Ranges explain uncertainty rather than hiding it
Includes a do-nothing and minimal-change alternative
verification: Reconcile estimates against repository size, current architecture, and existing test coverage

result.summary: Cumulative low/base/high cost model, dependency-aware lanes, critical path, alternatives, risks, and rollback boundaries.
